title: Plate 01: the anchor, live

techniques.name: Conoscopic figure

defect.label: Defect
defect.note: The defect in the crystal: a Maltese cross (s = +1, four brushes), two half-defects (s = ±½, two brushes each), or a schlieren field.

pol.label: Polarizer angle
pol.note: Turns the crossed polarizers; the brushes turn with them.

ret.label: Retardance
ret.note: Γ = d·Δn where the crystal is thickest (it falls to 130 nm at its thinnest). More retardance climbs more Michel-Lévy orders: gray, yellow, first-order red, teal.

plate.label: 530 nm plate
plate.note: The first-order red plate (530 nm) laid in at 45°: retardance adds where the crystal’s slow axis runs with the plate and subtracts across it, so the colors split blue and yellow by the sign of the defect, and thin, isotropic ground shows its magenta.

techniques.implementation: Rays and markers traced through a crystal model on black, with a color plate beside them. Drawn by the source page’s own code; each dial sets one of the page’s own controls or one of the numbers its drawing is built from.

techniques.name: Measured inks
techniques.implementation: solid ink pixels of each figure, read at full resolution, are clustered to five colors; a color is kept when it holds at least 4% of the ink.

techniques.name: Figure and ground
techniques.implementation: The ground is the most common border color of a figure; ink is every pixel more than 40 levels from it.

pass_order: read · points measured from the figure
